title: Invent your own colours

execution:

- But first, we will play a treasure hunt
- First clue - you are given 3 primary colour paints. Mix all three in equal amounts & find the resulting colour --- Will all the kids get exact same colour ? It might not match our colour

- In the pouch, next clue - take the 3 torches, show it on the wall, interect 3 & find the resulting colour
- Find the pouch in that colour
- 3rd clue - this item is blue +yellow, can fly & not from Earth, find it on the app & click on it
- Watch Little I Am video on how to create your own colours

story:
... 4 microbes. Wake up together for the first time ever, In a World that was brand new with no life before...
The world was new. They were new.
Each turned around and saw the other, first time they saw anything.
They then saw the blue liquid sourrounding them. The thing they were now in.
They decided to call it water, to make it easier to talk about it.
But one of them did not understand. They realised how these 3 were able to hear what others said & one of them couldn't. 
But they couldn't leave their friend alone.
So they deviced a clever trick. 
They used their 8 moving parts of their body, we call arms to show the word to the one that couldn't hear.
They used their arms to act out the word. 
Then slowly, with time, as they found out they could use the green slimey <things>
On the ground to make a mark on the hard surfaces of the rocks,
They started to paint, draw, & write . 
So they continued on discovering new things about this World they found themselves in 
and new things about themselves & each other.

title: Let grow and grow
activities:
1. Learn how a plant grows 
2. Plant a seed 
3. Water everyday & take care of it
4. Look forward to buds/new growth
execution:
- We are going to get our hands dirty and learn reponsibility & patience , love, care , life , relationship ...
- Let's grow a plant from scratch. They can see their friend grow from seed to plant & through rest of his life.
- First go to the app and watch a video on how plant grows (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ib5uiLMM2wY)
- Now Little Iam will explain how to prep soil and plant the seed
- Plant the seed and name the plant
- Water as per little I Am instructions
- Little Iam will remind you everyday to water the plant and have conversations with your new friend
- Zoom session on weekend to show the progress of plants & discuss with other kids 
- Options in the app to record the progress of the plant which you can show it to your friends & family

- Ask for help in the app if plant dries or looks dull 
- If not able to revive the plant , write a mourning note about how you feel losing the plant - Send an alternate sapling ?

- We can continue this over weeks, with playing music to the plant, doing experiments with plant to understand how much life it has, watching it, change, understand its behaviours, what it likes, doesnt, etc

title: Wonder Why!
activities:
1. Wonder Why! - game kit - 
 questions, situations , 
 followed by whys, 
 feelings & why
execution:
- This week, you are going to WonderWhy?! to anything & everything!
- We first start with a game. But this time, we are sending the rules of the game to your parents & its a secret.
- Parents start the activity by each drawing the same image & then ask the kid to judge which is best
- Then game starts, where they ask the kid why he/she judged so & keep asking why to every answer kid says & hear out all their answers fully & patiently, ask doubts & show its understood, before asking why again
- Parents can then try this, whenever opportunity presents, to help the kid, delve deeper into self & understand, the deeper context to their actions, decisions, etc
- Zoom session for kids - to WonderWhy! together - a particular topic or story - followed by kids wondering
- Play with the You Say Why game kit, with anyone or alone
- Kids also gain access to the WonderWhy! feature - where kids can ask questions & answer each other - voice enabled. moderated.
